mathematicalContract.covariance: Sigma_s=sum_{k=1}^5 theta_{s,k}^2 K_k, using the unchanged frozen owner PollCoordinates.kernels. K_ind=I; K_cycle=same cycle; K_race=same race and cycle; K_house=same pollster and cycle; K_movement=same race/cycle * min(days_i,days_j)/30. Movement SD retains the owner sqrt(30-day) convention.
mathematicalContract.jointVectorLikelihood: L_M(y|z,U_j,D_cal)=sum_s a_s Normal_6(y;mu(z,U_j),Sigma_s). One s is shared across the complete vector. product_i sum_s a_s Normal_1(...) is a different, excluded dependence law.
mathematicalContract.stableLogLikelihood: t_s=log(a_s)-0.5*[6log(2pi)+logdet(Sigma_s)+(y-mu)^T solve(Sigma_s,y-mu)]; ell=logsumexp_s(t_s), using stable subtraction ofmax(t), Cholesky log determinants/solves and float64. Preserve all normalization constants.
mathematicalContract.meanGradient: r_s(z,U_j)=exp(t_s-ell); d ell/d mu=sum_s r_s solve(Sigma_s,y-mu). Chain to native states with (d mu/d z)^T. No differentiation through frozen weights, coordinates, observed y or bank creation.
mathematicalContract.protectedPopulationTarget: q_j(z)=h_j(z)*L_M(y|z,U_j,D_cal)/Z_j, h_j(z)=p_0(z|U_j,C_pub)*L_other(D_other|z,U_j,C_pub); Z_j=integral h_j(z)*L_M dz finite and positive. P_cut(U_j,z)=w_j*q_j(z). sum/integral_z P_cut=w_j exactly in the mathematical target.
mathematicalContract.parentWeightRule: Never replace w_j by normalized w_j*Z_j, w_j*L_M or component responsibilities. The observed TX topology8x0.125 is an example, not a required population distribution; future actual parent IDs/masses require separately pinned native admission.
mathematicalContract.calibrationRowWeightSemantics: Input a_s are empirical calibration posterior masses. At fixed z, r_s are updated conditional responsibilities. Integrating z gives posterior component mass a_s*Z_{j,s}/sum_t a_t*Z_{j,t}, where Z_{j,s}=integral h_j(z)L_s dz. Input weights, conditional responsibilities and integrated posterior masses are three different quantities.
mathematicalContract.differentCalibrationCut: sum_s a_s*[h_j(z)L_s/Z_{j,s}] preserves calibration massesa_s after separate normalization for each(U_j,s). That is a different target, not this ordinary marginal likelihood. No repeated-fits calibration-cut scheduler is planned.
mathematicalContract.priorReuseRule: Do not multiply by the original log-SD prior or calibration likelihood again: the bank already represents their posterior. No extra SD Jacobian arises merely from using fixed SD values exp(log_scales). Existing native latent-coordinate Jacobians stay unchanged.
mathematicalContract.whatPrototypeDoesNotEstablish: Supplied-state density/gradient tests do not compute actual Z_j, prove composed full-cut moment conditions, authenticate all empirical sources or establish a fitted posterior. Future conditional inference need not numerically evaluate Z_j if a valid normalized conditional method is used.

singlePointIncumbent.expectedReduction: L_M=Normal_6 and all mean/native chain-rule gradients exactly reduce mathematically; preserve Gaussian determinant constants, nonpoll factors and physical outputs.

singlePointIncumbent.fairFutureBaseline: A later empirical comparison must use identical calibration data and explicitly matched prior/point-estimation definitions; original optimizer bounds cannot become scientific prior truncation by accident. Current limiting-case compatibility alone is not a fair historical algorithm comparison.

Measurement owner replaces exactly the existing fixed-covariance full-vector poll likelihood. Never leave the original poll factor active as well.

Environment/choice/counts/report owners retain their existing states, priors and factors. Poll-error cycle residual and latent final-election environment are not duplicates solely because both mention cycle; their conditional meanings must remain the admitted ones.

physicalSupportAndOwnership.nativeMeanManifold: All six frozen observations refer to the same final expected candidate pair. The native adapter must broadcast the one shared log-rate contrast to all six means, not invent six independently fitted election means. Free six-vector supplied means such asmu=y exercise the density oracle only and need not be realizable by a native count state. For the shared native contrast, its derivative is the sum of the six mean-coordinate derivatives.

covarianceReuseChallenges.decision: Independent kernel already includes sampling, weighting, rounding and residual measurement error. No extra sample-size/MOE/binomial variance, extra house bias, movement path or second calibrated shock is added. Changing any of those is a separate experimental arm.

Mean remains final expected named-pair log odds and covariance retains the owner movement kernel. Do not import the completed FS6 trend/momentum mean or infer a universal publication lag; a changed time target requires a new residual law and calibration.

Exact excluded events2020:TX and2024:TX do not prove independence from same-cycle other-state data or every downstream survey/report/count observation. Prototype actual-vector supplied-point use inherits only numerical scope. Before any full fit, audit C/Y/source IDs, events/cycles, labels and shared stochastic errors; use a justified conditional/joint law or a separately declared sensitivity. Do not repair overlap by silently reweighting bank rows or merely dropping duplicated labels.

Only one current six-poll vector is supported. Multiplying independently marginalized blocks with one globally uncertain scale bank would differ from summing a single shared scale over their product. A broader multi-block adapter must explicitly choose/prove the shared joint target; no automatic extension from the six-poll toy.

Current bank has field-end proxy availability and unverified original publication histories. A later cutoff alone does not upgrade strict as-of status; changing target years to match calibration years is prohibited.

All4000 whole rows retained with original input mass. Responsibilities may concentrate legitimately, but inspect conditional/integrated concentration and chain sensitivity before inference. No best-chain/best-component substitution or unreviewed downsampling; finite bank diagnostics are not forecast uncertainty or complete MCSE.

Keep polls out of structural priors unless the source law explicitly conditions on them once. C_pub is the realized publisher operator/control, not a random copy of a protected population draw or a second source observation.

practicalAndPrecisionGuards: Before any later fit, freeze a metric-specific minimum useful improvement and material-regression guard on its physical scale, the selected primary score, tie/inconclusive rule and resource budget in that future plan. V1 supplied-state prototype cannot supply those empirical thresholds. No run is allowed while they remain unspecified.

Separate conditional Monte Carlo error, finite-bank integration uncertainty and limited independent-election evidence. Check whole-chain/parent sensitivity without selecting chains; a small chain range is not complete MCSE.

A practical gain must exceed relevant numerical/integration uncertainty; unresolved precision retains incumbent. Coverage obtained only by widening intervals or an uninformative0.5 forecast is not usefulness.

Investigate materialA orB losses, shared-cycle dependence, count scale and minor-candidate allocation. No need win every cell, but oneA gain cannot hide damage to the other; label transfer unavailable if data missing.
